sloka: तथा प्रवर्त्यताम् यज्ञो भवद्भिः च मया सह ।विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा सर्व एव महर्षयः ॥१-६०-४॥
transliteration: tathā pravartyatām yajño bhavadbhiḥ ca mayā saha ।viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā sarva eva maharṣayaḥ ॥1-60-4॥

translations.english: Agreeing to these words of Viswamitra all the rishis, knowers of spiritual order and endowed with righteousness assembled there said:
